title: Open Night Train Database (ONTD)
description: The Open Night Train Database is Back-on-Track Europe's database of night trains in Europe: routes, trips, stops, operators, calendars and travel classes, in a structure inspired by GTFS. Volunteers keep it up to date in a shared spreadsheet, and it powers the night train map on back-on-track.eu. This record archives a release of the GitHub repository Back-on-Track-eu/night-train-data.
